_comment: Shipped preset for the Qwen3 4B local LLM as Storyboard Stage's backend. The stage now emits a provider-neutral instruction, so the local model applies its normal chat template. max_length is bumped to 6144 because long shot lists can exceed 2048 tokens.
label: Local Qwen3 4B Storyboard
description: Qwen3 4B as a structured-shotlist LLM. StoryboardStage builds the 16-field ChatML prompt and parses the line-by-line response back into a COMFYTV_STORYBOARD JSON. Requires qwen_3_4b.safetensors in models/text_encoders/.
